fluff.overview: After the Jihad stripped many elite units to fill battle armor companies, the LCAF recognized that conventional infantry remained essential for roles that battle armor could not cost-effectively fill. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable long-range missile launchers, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry weapon range, providing indirect fire support to the formation.
